name: capon_weak_partial
aim: Witness the unphysical ΔE>0 excursion in the WEAK/partial-absorption regime (phase-0's regime) under a fresh control. CAP ON at weak η=−0.2, 700 steps (t=28), full decomposition. PASS(a) if ΔE(vs RT0) rises above 0 while the component ledger stays exact.
method: identical ablation binary; CAP ON η=−0.2; 700 steps t=28; same cell/GS/WP; full energy decomposition + density_l2.

advisor_verdict.probe_reading: CAP ON η=−0.2, 700 steps (t=28): ΔE(vs RT0) drains to MIN −23.38 eV (t=21.6) then RISES +23.5 eV and CROSSES ABOVE 0 to +0.11 eV at step 700. Ledger EXACT (Σ8==E_total to 1.39e-13 Ha) throughout including the rise; density_l2→0.0001 (absorbed continuously even as E_total rises). Reproduces the phase-0 unphysical excursion under a fresh control.
advisor_verdict.decisive_control: capon_weak_partial vs capoff_floor: identical run except CAP strength. OFF => conserved never >0; weak ON => drains then rises +23.5 eV crossing >0, CAP the sole non-conservative term, ledger exact.
advisor_verdict.synthesis: The unphysical ΔE_total>0 excursion is a METHOD artifact of the non-Hermitian CAP, not physics. In the partial-absorption regime the CAP's contribution to the reported KS total-energy functional is sign-changing: after an initial drain it adds energy back into the reported E_total, driving it above the reference even while density is still being removed. Turning the CAP off restores strict conservation; the component sum stays exact to solver precision, ruling out reference (c), propagator/grid (d), and double-counting (e).

ledger.evidence: capoff_floor conserves never >0; capon_weak_partial (CAP ON η=−0.2) drains then rises +23.5 eV crossing >0 to +0.11 eV, CAP the sole non-conservative term, ledger exact to 1.39e-13 Ha.
v_bg on in all probes, no independent drift; not causal. +v_bg-only control not run.
component sum==E_total to 1e-13 Ha; capoff conserves vs RT0; +221 eV vs E_GS is flat WP offset.
same ETRS/grid/dt conserve CAP-off; CAP-on drift fully accounted by CAP term.
component sum==E_total to 1e-13 Ha through full absorption incl. rise; Σε_i band≠total, benign.
